statement.zh: Boyd Hawes 等 1908 年正式出版古尔尼亚、瓦西iliki 及耶拉佩特拉地峡相关史前遗址发掘报告。
statement.en: Boyd Hawes et al. 1908 formally published excavations at Gournia, Vasiliki, and related prehistoric sites on the Hierapetra isthmus.
